bootstrap_calibration.covariance_treatment: the covariance estimate and its retained eigenmodes are held fixed while every bootstrap null replicate is refitted
bootstrap_calibration.global_lack_of_fit: add each centered noise vector to the fitted nine-parameter free quadratic null, refit all nine parameters, and recompute Q
bootstrap_calibration.joint_intercept_test: add each centered noise vector to the fitted exact-intercept quadratic null, refit both six-parameter restricted and nine-parameter unrestricted models, and recompute Delta Q
bootstrap_calibration.parameter_uncertainty: refit the unrestricted model to central vector plus each stored centered bootstrap noise vector
bootstrap_calibration.source: stored upstream replica-first, time-block-second hierarchical bootstrap vectors

covariance_regularization.covariance_construction: block diagonal across lattice sizes from the sample covariance of the stored three-observable hierarchical-bootstrap vectors
covariance_regularization.method: eigendecomposition of the 15x15 correlation matrix; retain lambda > relative_threshold * lambda_max and evaluate GLS in the retained whitened modes

stress_threshold.purpose: conservative sensitivity check that truncates the weakest correlation eigenmode; it is not used for the primary result

data.independence_structure: independent simulations at different lattice sizes; full three-observable bootstrap covariance retained within each size
data.joint_observation_order: increasing L, then peak_center_h, peak_magnitude, fwhm_h

degrees_of_freedom.asymptotic_chi_square_p_values: reported as secondary diagnostics; bootstrap-calibrated p values are primary
degrees_of_freedom.global_lack_of_fit: retained covariance rank minus unrestricted whitened-design rank
degrees_of_freedom.joint_intercept_test: unrestricted whitened-design rank minus restricted whitened-design rank; three when all intercept restrictions are estimable

limitations: The test conditions on the upstream scalar-extraction and bootstrap procedure.
The finite-size ansatz is quadratic in 1/V over the five simulated sizes; the global lack-of-fit test checks this ansatz against the retained covariance modes.
The bootstrap calibrates finite-sample noise but does not replace an analytic proof of the thermodynamic limit.

model.restricted_null: the three A_X are fixed jointly to the exact limiting vector; all three B_X and C_X remain free
